title: CounterOffer
description: A requester's single-round counter-offer proposing a lower price for an existing task (the 'task.counter' message body, RFC-0002). The provider accepts if 'proposed_price' meets or exceeds its private reservation, otherwise it holds its floor. There is no unbounded haggling: one counter per task.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task being re-negotiated (from the prior task.offer).

proposed_price.description: The price the requester proposes. The provider's reservation is unknown to the requester by design.

currency.description: Optional currency code for 'proposed_price'; defaults to the offer's currency.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
